source.document: CCPA Guidelines for Prevention and Regulation of Greenwashing, 2024

explain.en: Generic broad terms such as 'eco-friendly' or 'green' require specific qualifying scope and accessible substantiation.

remediation.en: Specify the exact environmental attribute (e.g. 'made with 40% post-consumer recycled plastic') and link a verifiable certificate or standard.

tests.input: Eco-friendly bottle made with 50% post-consumer recycled PET (certificate: ISO-14021)
tests.notes: Qualified with recycled content and ISO standard reference
